A FEW GOOD QUESTIONS

Curious?
Good.

Can I get something completely custom-made?+

Absolutely—start by sharing your idea on WhatsApp. We’ll discuss what is possible, the design work needed, materials, size and a quotation.

How do I place an order?+

Choose a collection or personalise an idea, then use the enquiry button to start a WhatsApp conversation. We’ll confirm the details, price and next steps with you. No payment is taken on this website.

Can you make a miniature from my photos?+

We can discuss solo and couple miniatures. Share clear, well-lit photos directly in WhatsApp so we can review the reference, style and feasibility before confirming your order.

How long will my print take?+

Timing depends on the size, complexity, finish and quantity. We’ll confirm an estimated production and delivery timeline with your quotation.

Do you work with businesses and bulk orders?+

Yes. Tell us your idea, quantity, deadline and branding requirements. We’ll discuss the design and suitable production options with you.
